title: UPDATE: EmbeddingGemma 2 Finetune Leads Vietnamese Speech Recognition Benchmarks

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The use of eight H100 GPUs for two hours transformed Google's EmbeddingGemma 2 into a state-of-the-art tool for Vietnamese speech recognition after training on 3,000 hours of audio. This development expands the utility of the embedding model into speech-to-text tasks, following another community project that repurposed the model to transcribe one hour of audio in about 13 seconds on a base M3 MacBook Air.

EmbeddingGemma 2 is an open model with 740M parameters that maps text, code, images, video, and audio into a unified 768-dimensional vector space. It features a modular design allowing on-device applications to load only necessary components, such as the 270M parameter text core or 300M parameter audio encoder. Released under an Apache 2.0 license, the model powers local AI tools including the DigUp search app and Google's AI Edge Foresight for macOS.

selectedTweets.text:
I turned @googlegemma  EmbeddingGemma 2, an embedding model, into a speech-to-text model, and it turned out to be one of the fastest STT models you can run on device. 

On a base M3 MacBook Air it transcribes an hour of audio in about 13 seconds: 288× real time.

The idea came in March with Gemini Embedding 2. It puts text, images, audio and video into one shared space, so a spoken word lands right next to the written word. If that's true, you should be able to read a transcript straight out of the embedding model. I couldnt tried it then, but last week EmbeddingGemma 2 came out as an open model, so I tried it.

selectedTweets.bestBit: outperforms some specialist models more than twice its size
selectedTweets.text:
Introducing EmbeddingGemma 2, a new open multimodal model that sets the standard for on-device efficiency.

- our first open, natively multimodal embedding model
- handles text, code, image, video, and audio tasks within a lightweight, modular 740M parameter form factor
- ideal for offline, privacy-first RAG when paired with Gemma 4
- outperforms some specialist models more than twice its size

Weights available now on Hugging Face.

selectedTweets.bestBit: The 740M footprint is modular: text: 270M vision: 170M audio: 300M
selectedTweets.text:
The 740M footprint is modular:
- text: 270M
- vision: 170M
- audio: 300M

Disable unused encoders through config_kwargs. Text-only loads 270M, text + images 440M, text + audio 570M.

Designed to also work on phones & laptops by loading only the encoders that you need. https://t.co/gPtFxiuxc2
